meta.name: aws-lambda-functions
meta.description: Create and deploy serverless functions using AWS Lambda with event sources, permissions, layers, and environment configuration. Use for event-driven computing without managing servers.

copy.tagline: 创建并部署 AWS Lambda 无服务器函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AWS 上快速构建和部署无服务器函数
copy.tagline_en: Create and deploy AWS Lambda serverless functions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly build and deploy serverless functions on AWS

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能帮您创建和部署AWS Lambda无服务器函数，配置事件源、权限、层和环境变量，无需管理服务器。
howto.when: 当您提出与AWS Lambda相关的问题或任务时触发，例如创建函数、配置触发器或部署代码。

say.text: 帮我创建一个Node.js的Lambda函数，用于处理API请求。
say.note: Claude将生成创建函数的AWS CLI命令或指导。

say.text: 部署一个Lambda函数，当S3有新文件时自动处理。
say.note: Claude会配置S3事件源和函数代码。

say.text: 添加一个Lambda层，共享代码到多个函数。
say.note: Claude会指导如何创建和附加层。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create and deploy AWS Lambda serverless functions, configure event sources, permissions, layers, and environment variables, without managing servers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions or tasks related to AWS Lambda, such as creating functions, configuring triggers, or deploying code.

say_en.text: Create a Node.js Lambda function to handle API requests.
say_en.note: Claude will generate AWS CLI commands or guidance.

say_en.text: Deploy a Lambda function that processes new S3 uploads automatically.
say_en.note: Claude will configure S3 event source and function code.

say_en.text: Add a Lambda layer to share code across multiple functions.
say_en.note: Claude will guide creating and attaching layers.
